SELECT a.store_id, s.name AS store_name,
a.campaign, a.seller_sku,
SUM(COALESCE(a.impressions, 0)) AS impressions, SUM(COALESCE(a.clicks, 0)) AS clicks, SUM(a.spend) AS spend, SUM(COALESCE(a.ad_sales, 0)) AS ad_sales, SUM(COALESCE(a.ad_orders, 0)) AS ad_orders FROM ecom_ad_daily a JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = a.store_id
a.store_id = #{storeId} AND a.ad_date >= #{beginDate} AND a.ad_date <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY a.store_id, s.name
, a.campaign , a.seller_sku
ORDER BY spend DESC
